name: ChangesPanel
description: A file against what was last saved. It updates as the file changes.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

name: ChangesView
description: Files with unsaved edits, each opening its comparison with what was saved.

name: CodeEditor
description:
Edits a document of any size in a bounded box. Give the parent a definite height (R7.3).
Use `document` for files, and `value` or `defaultValue` for short content.
signature: ({ "aria-label": label, document, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, lexer, readOnly, invalid, describedBy, onStatus, screenReader, framed, className, ref }: CodeEditorProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the editor for assistive technology.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial text when uncontrolled.

props.name: describedBy
props.description: The id of an element describing the editor.

props.name: document
props.description: A document of any size, from `openFile` or `connectDocument`. Takes priority over `value`.

props.name: framed
props.description: Draw the editor's own edge and corners, as a control has. Turn it off inside a panel or window body that already frames it.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the content as failing validation.

props.name: lexer
props.description: Highlighting rules, such as `typescriptLexer`.

props.name: onStatus
props.description: Reports the caret, the size tier and the line numbers' exactness.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the text after an edit. Not called for a `document`.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Keeps navigation, selection and copy, and refuses edits.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: screenReader
props.description: Mirror the current line into the input, for screen readers.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled text, for short content. A large file belongs in a `document`.

name: CodeField
description:
Code in a form: a `Field` holding an editor, so it has a label, a hint and an error like any other
control, and works with `useAppForm` through `value`, `onValueChange` and `onBlur`.
signature: ({ label, hint, error, warning, optional, required, aside, message, className, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, onBlur, lexer, readOnly, height }: CodeFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial text when uncontrolled.

props.name: height
props.description: The editor's height. Default 11rem.

props.name: lexer
props.description: Highlighting rules, such as `typescriptLexer`.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when focus leaves, for a form's validate-on-blur (R15.9).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the text after an edit.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Keeps navigation, selection and copy, and refuses edits.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled text.

props.name: aside
props.description: Right side of the label row: a live value readout or a small link.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: error
props.description: Replaces the hint in place. Setting it marks the field and its control invalid.

props.name: hint
props.description: The message line's resting text. Only when the format or consequence is not obvious (R2.8).

props.name: label
props.description: Names the control. Omit only when a group legend or `aria-label` names it instead.

props.name: message
props.description:
reserve: the message line always exists (default for vertical fields), so an error
never moves anything (R9.1). auto: only rendered when there is a hint, error or counter.

props.name: optional
props.description: Marks the label "Optional". Prefer this over marking required fields.

props.name: required
props.description: Shows the required marker. Pass `required` to the control as well.

props.name: warning
props.description: Non-blocking warning in the reserved message slot; errors take precedence.

name: CodeViewer
description: Shows code of any size, with the same scrolling and highlighting, and no editing.

name: EditorArea
description:
The tabbed, splittable editors and the panels beneath them. Drag a tab to split, or use its
menu. It fills its parent, which needs a definite height.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: collapseBelow
props.description: Below this width the layout shows one panel at a time with a strip of the rest. Default "28rem", a phone.

name: ExplorerView
description: The Explorer: open files, then the project's folders, with a filter that stays put.

name: FileExplorer
description:
A file tree over any `FileProvider`. Folders load when opened and rows offer only what the
provider can do: without `rename` there is no rename, so a read-only source simply reads.
signature: ({ providers, query, selected, onOpen, onOpenInWindow, ref }: FileExplorerProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Called when a person opens a file. `preview` is a single click, which a later open may replace.

props.name: onOpenInWindow
props.description: Adds Open in new window to each file's menu.

props.name: providers
props.description: Where files come from. With more than one, each is a top-level folder.

props.name: query
props.description: Filters rows by name.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: selected
props.description: The file shown as selected.

name: OutputPanel
description: A running record of what the workbench did.

name: ProblemsPanel
description: Every open file's diagnostics, grouped by file, from whichever provider the application connected.

name: SearchView
description: Search across files: `backend.search` when the application has one, otherwise in the page.

props.name: defaultQuery
props.description: What to search for at first.

name: TimelineView
description: The active file's undo history as a timeline, with its branches. Choosing a step goes back, or forward, to it.

name: WelcomePanel
description: What an editor stack shows when nothing is open.

name: Workbench
description:
An IDE as one component: application frame, activity rail, side views, tabbed and splittable
editors, code windows, panels, menus, commands and a status bar. It fills its parent, which needs
a definite height. To use the parts in a shell you already have, start from `WorkbenchProvider`.
signature: ({ windows, brand, actions, account, views, inspector, ...provider }: WorkbenchProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: account
props.description: The end of the top bar, usually an `AccountButton`.

props.name: actions
props.description: Beside the search in the top bar, such as a theme toggle.

props.name: backend
props.description: Where files come from and what provides language features. Only `files` is needed.

props.name: brand
props.description: The top-left corner, usually a `ShellBrand`.

props.name: createWorker
props.description: Makes a document worker. Default: the package's worker, which most bundlers can find.

props.name: initialFiles
props.description: Files open at the start.

props.name: inspector
props.description: A second side pane, usually an `Inspector`.

props.name: lexers
props.description: Highlighting by file extension, such as `{ ts: typescriptLexer }`.

props.name: panels
props.description: The application's own panels, beside Problems and Output.

props.name: recovery
props.description:
Where unsaved edits are kept, so a crash or a closed tab loses nothing: they are offered back
when the file next opens. Default: the browser's IndexedDB. `null` keeps none.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: Where the layout is remembered. Leave out to remember nothing.

props.name: views
props.description: The application's own views, after Explorer, Search and Changes.

props.name: windows
props.description: The window manager to open code windows in. Default: one of its own.

name: WorkbenchMenubar
description: The workbench's menus, built from its commands, so a menu row, a shortcut and the palette always agree.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: viewCommands
props.description: Commands of your own, shown at the end of the View menu.

name: WorkbenchProvider
description:
Holds a workbench's open files, layout, commands and dialogs, and draws nothing else. Use it to
place the parts in an application that already has its own shell. `Workbench` is this with a
frame around it. It needs a `PaletteProvider` above it, and a `WindowManagerProvider` for files
to open in managed windows.

props.name: backend
props.description: Where files come from and what provides language features. Only `files` is needed.

props.name: children
props.description: The parts: `EditorArea`, the views and panels, and anything else that uses {@link useWorkbench }.

props.name: createWorker
props.description: Makes a document worker. Default: the package's worker, which most bundlers can find.

props.name: initialFiles
props.description: Files open at the start.

props.name: lexers
props.description: Highlighting by file extension, such as `{ ts: typescriptLexer }`.

props.name: panels
props.description: The application's own panels, beside Problems and Output.

props.name: recovery
props.description:
Where unsaved edits are kept, so a crash or a closed tab loses nothing: they are offered back
when the file next opens. Default: the browser's IndexedDB. `null` keeps none.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: Where the layout is remembered. Leave out to remember nothing.

name: WorkbenchStatusBar
description: The bar under a workbench: problems, the caret, the file's size and any shortcut in progress.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.
